parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the application. You can specify only one application ID in each request.

parameters.name: ChannelId
parameters.description: The ID of the channel. You can specify only one channel ID in each request.

parameters.name: TerminalIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the users that you want to remove.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live remove-terminals --app-id aec0000 --channel-id testId --terminal-ids 18110000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live RemoveTerminals --region cn-hangzhou --TerminalIds.1 18110000 --AppId aec0000 --ChannelId testId
